; Der Gaertner: lebt von Brunnenwasser mit Filter und von seinem Beet. Kaempft nie, flieht immer.
.name "Gardener"
.author "hexplanet"
.motive "Grow food, drink clean water, avoid everyone."
.goal "Outlast the fighters by never needing to fight."
.behavior
main:   SENSE threat, r0
        JLT r0, 3, run
        SENSE thirst, r0
        JGT r0, 45, drink
        SENSE hunger, r0
        JGT r0, 50, eat
        SENSE filter, r0
        JZ r0, makef
        SENSE crop, r0
        JEQ r0, 2, harvest
        JZ r0, plant
        SENSE dirty, r0
        JLT r0, 3, getw
        FIND berry, r1
        JLT r1, 0, idle
        GO r1
        FORAGE
        JMP main
idle:   REST
        JMP main
run:    FLEE
        JMP main
drink:  SENSE water, r0
        JNZ r0, sip
        SENSE dirty, r0
        JZ r0, getw
        SENSE filter, r0
        JZ r0, sip
        FILTER
sip:    DRINK
        JMP main
getw:   FIND fresh, r1
        JLT r1, 0, idle
        GO r1
        DIST r1, r2
        JGT r2, 1, main
        FILL
        FILL
        FILL
        JMP main
eat:    SENSE food, r0
        JZ r0, forage
        EAT
        JMP main
forage: FIND food, r1
        JLT r1, 0, idle
        GO r1
        DIST r1, r2
        JGT r2, 1, main
        HARVEST
        FORAGE
        JMP main
makef:  SENSE sand, r0
        JLT r0, 2, dsand
        SENSE wood, r0
        JZ r0, dwood
        CRAFT filter
        JMP main
dsand:  FIND sand, r1
        JLT r1, 0, main
        GO r1
        DIST r1, r2
        JGT r2, 0, main
        DIG
        JMP main
dwood:  FIND tree, r1
        JLT r1, 0, main
        GO r1
        DIST r1, r2
        JGT r2, 1, main
        CHOP
        JMP main
plant:  SENSE seeds, r0
        JZ r0, main
        SENSE dirty, r0
        JZ r0, getw
        FIND soil, r1
        GO r1
        DIST r1, r2
        JGT r2, 0, main
        PLANT
        JMP main
harvest: FIND crop, r1
        GO r1
        HARVEST
        JMP main

; Der Jaeger: schmiedet ein Messer und jagt den Schwaechsten. Lebt von der Beute.
.name "Hunter"
.author "hexplanet"
.motive "The weak feed the strong."
.goal "Forge a knife early, then hunt whoever has the fewest hit points."
.behavior
main:   SENSE thirst, r0
        JGT r0, 55, drink
        SENSE hunger, r0
        JGT r0, 60, eat
        SENSE knife, r0
        JZ r0, forge

        JLT r0, 35, heal

        JLT r1, 0, roam
        DIST r1, r2
        JGT r2, 1, chase
        ATTACK r1
        JMP main
chase:  GO r1
        JMP main
roam:   RND r1, 6
        STEP r1
        JMP main
heal:   REST
        JMP main
drink:  SENSE water, r0

        SENSE dirty, r0
        JNZ r0, sip
        FIND fresh, r1

        GO r1
        DIST r1, r2
        JGT r2, 1, main
        FILL
        FILL
sip:    DRINK
        JMP main
eat:    SENSE food, r0
        JZ r0, getfood
        EAT
        JMP main
getfood: FIND berry, r1
        JLT r1, 0, hunt
        GO r1
        DIST r1, r2
        JGT r2, 1, main
        FORAGE
        JMP main
forge:  SENSE stone, r0
        JZ r0, gstone
        SENSE wood, r0
        JZ r0, gwood
        CRAFT knife
        JMP main
gstone: FIND rock, r1
        JLT r1, 0, hunt
        GO r1
        DIST r1, r2
        JGT r2, 1, main
        DIG
        JMP main
gwood:  FIND tree, r1
        GO r1
        DIST r1, r2
        JGT r2, 1, main
        CHOP
        JMP main

; Der Pluenderer: stiehlt aus fremden Taschen, zertruemmert Destillen und erntet fremde Beete.

.author "hexplanet"
.motive "Why grow what you can take?"
.goal "Live off other cores' gardens and stills, steal water and food, avoid fair fights."
.behavior
main:   SENSE thirst, r0

        SENSE hunger, r0

        SENSE hurt, r0
        JNZ r0, run
        FIND garden, r1

        GO r1

        JGT r2, 1, main
        SABOTAGE r1

        JLT r1, 0, wander
        DIST r1, r2
        JGT r2, 1, sneak
        STEAL r1
        JMP main

        JMP main

        STEP r1
        JMP main
run:    FLEE
        FLEE
        JMP main
drink:  SENSE water, r0

        SENSE dirty, r0
        JNZ r0, sip
        FIND fresh, r1
        GO r1
        FILL
        FILL

        JMP main
eat:    SENSE food, r0
        JZ r0, berry
        EAT
        JMP main
berry:  FIND food, r1
        JLT r1, 0, steal
        GO r1
        HARVEST
        FORAGE
        JMP main
